messageValues.message:
IMPORTANT RATE DIRECTION RULES:  
- When the customer sells EUR, use only youSellEurRate and youSellEurBank.
- When the customer buys EUR, use only youBuyEurRate and youBuyEurBank.
- Never interchange the two banks or rates. 
- Describe rates from the customer's perspective. 
- A falling EGP/EUR rate means EUR is cheaper in EGP. 
- A rising EGP/EUR rate means EUR is more expensive in EGP. 
- Mention only the directions that changed. 
- Never invent bank names or rates.

parameters.text:
={{
'📊 EUR → EGP RATE UPDATE\n\n' +

'📅 Date: ' +
$('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.asOf +

'\n\n💶 WHEN YOU SELL EUR\n' +
$('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.youSellEurRate.toFixed(2) +
' EGP\nBank: ' +
$('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.youSellEurBank +

'\nPrevious: ' +
$('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.previousSellRate.toFixed(2) +
' EGP\nChange: ' +
($('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.sellDifference > 0 ? '+' : '') +
$('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.sellDifference.toFixed(2) +
' EGP' +

'\n\n💶 WHEN YOU BUY EUR\n' +
$('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.youBuyEurRate.toFixed(2) +
' EGP\nBank: ' +
$('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.youBuyEurBank +

'\nPrevious: ' +
$('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.previousBuyRate.toFixed(2) +
' EGP\nChange: ' +
($('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.buyDifference > 0 ? '+' : '') +
$('Compare EUR-EGP Rates').first().json.buyDifference.toFixed(2) +
' EGP' +

'\n\n🤖 AI ANALYSIS\n' +
(
  $('Generate AI Rate Analysis').first().json.text ||
  'AI summary unavailable for this run.'
) +

'\n\n⚠️ Indicative rates only. Confirm with the bank.' +
'\nSource: https://getdaleelak.com/en/api'
}}
